title: WorkCam Evidence Record Schema v1.x (machine-readable contract)

protocol_versions.1.0: stable; float repr formatting (Python-side risk documented in B02-W023 F2)
protocol_versions.1.1: stable; %.10g float formatting with decimal point guarantee

canonical_payload.format: UTF-8 text, key=value lines, fixed field order, trailing newline
rules: timestamps are ISO 8601 with explicit offset or Z
v1.1 floats: finite only, %.10g, must contain '.' or 'e'

unknown_version_policy.rule: A record with an unrecognized version string MUST NOT be marked trusted at ANY level. Verifiers report protocol_version=unknown and signature checks are skipped (nothing to verify against); file-integrity checks still apply.
unknown_version_policy.rational: forward compat requires explicit opt-in after review, never silent acceptance

protocol_version.known_versions_note: verifiers treat anything else per unknown_version_policy

record_id.description: evidence unique id; uuid-hex or record hash prefix

sequence_number.description: monotonic per-device record counter; 0 allowed for first record; upper bound mirrors the production SignatureManifest model (TM44 fuzz found the doc/model gap)

previous_record_hash.description: hash-chain link to prior record; null ONLY for chain origin

photo_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immutable original bytes

capture_timestamp.description: device-claimed capture time, ISO 8601; UNTRUSTED client input

device_reported_time.description: device wall clock at signing; UNTRUSTED client input

device_id.description: client-claimed device label; binding strength comes from the registered public key, not this string

location.description: client-claimed GNSS/other fix; UNTRUSTED client input

signature.description: Base64 DER ECDSA-P256-SHA256 over the canonical payload

public_key_b64.description: Base64 X9.63 uncompressed P-256 point (65 bytes)

anchor_reference.description: OPTIONAL v1.x extension slot: server time-anchor receipt id bound at sync time. Not part of the signed payload in v1.x; carried beside it. Future v2 may fold it into the signed field set (REVIEW REQUIRED before that change).

derivative_refs.description: OPTIONAL: hashes of derivative images derived from this original; derivatives are NEVER trusted originals

extensions.description: OPTIONAL forward-compat bag; verifiers MUST ignore unknown keys here (unlike unknown protocol_version)

invariants: original photo bytes are immutable after upload; any re-write invalidates photo_hash
signature validity != content authenticity != hardware attestation
math validity alone never promotes a record past signature_valid=true
